tasks.title: L1 lookahead distance
tasks.statement: ArduPlane: ground speed **{v} m/s**, `NAVL1_PERIOD` = **{T}**, `NAVL1_DAMPING` = **{z}**. Find L1 (m).

tasks.title: Pure pursuit lateral acceleration
tasks.statement: Speed **{v} m/s**, lookahead distance **{L} m**, angle to the lookahead point **{a}°**. Find the lateral acceleration (m/s²).

tasks.title: Trapezoidal move time
tasks.statement: Move of **{D} m**, velocity limit **{v} m/s**, acceleration **{a} m/s²** (acceleration and deceleration are equal; the distance is long enough to reach the limit). Find the move time (s).
tasks.solution: Acceleration v/a, deceleration v/a, covering v²/a between them; cruise (D − v²/a)/v. Total D/v + v/a.
